primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in percentage of liver fat assessed by MRI at week 24.
efficacy_outcome: Liver fat change was 0.00 with placebo, −1.68 with pradigastat 5 mg/10 mg (p=0.3128), and −2.89 with pradigastat 10 mg/20 mg (p=0.0457).
safety_signal: Serious AEs occurred in 3/20 placebo participants, 1/11 in the 5 mg/10 mg group, and 2/21 in the 10 mg/20 mg group; deaths were not reported.
